semester_update_reminder.subject: Please complete your semester update

routine_changed.subject: Your class routine changed

test.subject: Test email
test.body: This is a test email for {name}.

verify_email.subject: Confirm your email address
verify_email.body:
Hello {name},

Open this link to confirm your email address. It works once and lasts 24 hours:
{link}

If you did not sign up, ignore this email.

email_change_confirm.subject: Confirm your new email address
email_change_confirm.body:
Hello {name},

Open this link to make this your new email address. It works once and lasts 24 hours:
{link}

Until then your old address stays in use. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.

email_changed_notice.subject: Your email address was changed
email_changed_notice.body:
Hello {name},

The email address on your account was changed. From now on you sign in with the new address.

If this was not you, contact your department admin.

already_registered.subject: You already have an account

reset_password.subject: Reset your password
reset_password.body:
Hello {name},

Open this link to choose a new password. It works once and lasts 1 hour:
{link}

If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.

password_changed.subject: Your password was changed

failed_logins.subject: Many failed sign-in attempts on your account

second_step_code.subject: Your sign-in code
second_step_code.body:
Hello {name},

Your sign-in code is {code}. It works once and lasts 10 minutes. If you did not try to sign in, change your password.

admin_role_changed.subject: Your admin access changed
admin_role_changed.body:
Hello,

Your admin access was changed ({change}: {role}). You were signed out everywhere. Sign in again to continue; admin accounts always use the second step.

admin_password_reset.subject: A super admin reset your password
admin_password_reset.body:
Hello {name},

A super admin started a password reset for your account. Open this link to choose a new password. It works once and lasts 1 hour:
{link}

You were signed out everywhere.

admin_second_step_reset.subject: Your second step was reset
admin_second_step_reset.body:
Hello {name},

A super admin reset your second step. You were signed out everywhere. At your next sign-in you will set up the authenticator app again.

teacher_approved.subject: Your teacher account was approved

teacher_rejected.subject: Your teacher registration was not approved

role_assigned.subject: You are now {role} of {section}

role_removed.subject: Your {role} role was removed

join_accepted.subject: You joined {section}

join_rejected.subject: Your join request was not accepted

group_changed.subject: Your lab group changed

department_without_admin.subject: A department has no active admin

class_cancelled.subject: A class was cancelled
class_cancelled.body:
Hello,

{course_code} on {date} has been cancelled. Your routine and the room for that time are updated.

Open the app to see your routine:
{link}

class_restored.subject: A cancelled class is back on
class_restored.body:
Hello,

{course_code} on {date} is back on.

Open the app to see your routine:
{link}

room_request_result.subject: Your room request has been decided

booking_cancelled.subject: A room booking was cancelled
booking_cancelled.body:
Hello,

The booking for {room} on {date} has been cancelled.

Open the app to see the latest routine:
{link}

request_expired.subject: Your room request expired
request_expired.body:
Hello,

Your room request for {room} on {date} expired before a decision was made.

Open the app to request again:
{link}
